visualCharacteristics: Info-card slider of square or 2:3 image cards with category label, plus glyph and title; abstract revealed on hover/tap; prev/next arrows, optional looping scale or autoplay rail.
contentPattern: One row per card: picture (optional mobile crop) | optional category paragraph | heading with card link | abstract paragraph(s).
usage: Use for a 'Discover our labs' style slider of image cards that reveal an abstract on hover.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any set of labs, services or capabilities by adding one row per card with image, title link and abstract.
